item.text: The SSH server already parses this prefix during its handshake, but the multiplexer rejects the connection first because it only recognizes `SSH` at the start. I’ll add classification in the multiplexer and pass `ClientAddr` through its connection wrapper while leaving the prefix available to the existing server parser.

+type fragmentedConn struct {
+	net.Conn
+	reader io.Reader
+	remote net.Addr
+}
+
+func (c *fragmentedConn) Read(p []byte) (int, error) { return c.reader.Read(p) }
+func (c *fragmentedConn) RemoteAddr() net.Addr       { return c.remote }
+
+type fragmentReader struct {
+	data []byte
+	size int
+}
+
+func (r *fragmentReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
+	if len(r.data) == 0 {
+		return 0, io.EOF
+	}
+	if len(p) > r.size {
+		p = p[:r.size]
+	}
+	n := copy(p, r.data)
+	r.data = r.data[n:]
+	return n, nil
+}
+
+func TestConnectionWrapperProxyHeader(t *testing.T) {
+	const sshVersion = "SSH-2.0-client\r\n"
+	originalAddr := &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1"), Port: 3000}
+	clientAddr := "192.0.2.10:12345"
+	traceContext := map[string]string{"traceparent": strings.Repeat("a", 300)}
+	payload, err := json.Marshal(apisshutils.HandshakePayload{
+		ClientAddr:     clientAddr,
+		TracingContext: traceContext,
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Greater(t, len(payload), MaxVersionStringBytes)
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name       string
+		input      string
+		fragment   int
+		wantRemote string
+		wantTrace  map[string]string
+		wantType   net.Addr
+	}{
+		{
+			name:       "fragmented proxy header",
+			input:      apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature + string(payload) + "\x00" + sshVersion,
+			fragment:   1,
+			wantRemote: clientAddr,
+			wantTrace:  traceContext,
+			wantType:   &net.TCPAddr{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "non-IP client address",
+			input:      apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature + `{"clientAddr":"proxy.internal:2345"}` + "\x00" + sshVersion,
+			fragment:   2,
+			wantRemote: "proxy.internal:2345",
+			wantType:   &utils.NetAddr{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "ordinary SSH",
+			input:      sshVersion,
+			fragment:   1,
+			wantRemote: originalAddr.String(),
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "invalid JSON",
+			input:      apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature + "{\x00" + sshVersion,
+			fragment:   3,
+			wantRemote: originalAddr.String(),
+		},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			conn := &fragmentedConn{
+				reader: &fragmentReader{data: []byte(tt.input), size: tt.fragment},
+				remote: originalAddr,
+			}
+			wrapped := wrapConnection(conn, logrus.New())
+			got, err := io.ReadAll(wrapped)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, sshVersion, string(got))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantRemote, wrapped.RemoteAddr().String())
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantTrace, map[string]string(wrapped.traceContext))
+			if tt.wantType != nil {

+		})
+	}

+func TestMuxPrefixedSSH(t *testing.T) {
+	const sshVersion = "SSH-2.0-test\r\n"
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		wire       string
+		clientAddr string
+		splitAt    int
+	}{
+		{
+			name:       "client address",
+			wire:       apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature + `{"clientAddr":"192.0.2.10:3022","tracingContext":{"test":"value"}}` + "\x00" + sshVersion,
+			clientAddr: "192.0.2.10:3022",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "split header",
+			wire:       apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature + `{"clientAddr":"198.51.100.25:2022"}` + "\x00" + sshVersion,
+			clientAddr: "198.51.100.25:2022",
+			splitAt:    len(apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature) + len(`{"clientAddr":"198.`),
+		},
+		{
+			name: "no client address",
+			wire: apisshutils.ProxyHelloSignature + `{}` + "\x00" + sshVersion,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "ordinary SSH",
+			wire: sshVersion,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+			defer cancel()
+
+			listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			mux, err := New(Config{Listener: listener, Context: ctx})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			sshListener := mux.SSH()
+			go mux.Serve()
+			defer func() {
+				require.NoError(t, mux.Close())
+				mux.Wait()
+			}()
+
+			client, err := net.Dial("tcp", listener.Addr().String())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			require.NoError(t, client.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5*time.Second)))
+			if tt.splitAt > 0 {
+				_, err = io.WriteString(client, tt.wire[:tt.splitAt])
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
+				_, err = io.WriteString(client, tt.wire[tt.splitAt:])
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+			} else {
+				_, err = io.WriteString(client, tt.wire)
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+			}
+
+			accepted, err := sshListener.Accept()
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer accepted.Close()
+			require.NoError(t, accepted.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5*time.Second)))
+
+			remote, ok := accepted.RemoteAddr().(*net.TCPAddr)
+			require.True(t, ok, "SSH remote address should be a TCP address")
+			wantRemote := client.LocalAddr().String()
+			if tt.clientAddr != "" {
+				wantRemote = tt.clientAddr
+			}
+			require.Equal(t, wantRemote, remote.String())
+
+			got := make([]byte, len(tt.wire))
+			_, err = io.ReadFull(accepted, got)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wire, string(got))
+		})
+	}
+}

item.text:
Implemented `Teleport-Proxy` SSH support. The [multiplexer](/app/lib/multiplexer/multiplexer.go) now routes valid prefixed connections to SSH and exposes `ClientAddr` through `RemoteAddr()`. The [SSH server parser](/app/lib/sshutils/server.go) handles fragmented headers up to 64 KiB while preserving tracing metadata. Tests cover ordinary SSH behavior.

Two subagents worked on mux tests and server parsing tests. I reviewed the combined patch; `go test ./lib/multiplexer ./lib/sshutils -count=1` and `git diff --check` passed.
